items.title: Free Certified Patch for Critical Rails Active Storage Vulnerability
items.summary: Socket has released a free Certified Patch for a critical Rails Active Storage vulnerability, giving developers time to upgrade to a secure Rails version.

items.title: Shai-Hulud Descendant Surfaces in Malicious Ruby Gem That Steals Credentials and Poisons AI Tools
items.summary: A malicious Ruby gem runs a credential-stealing worm during installation, poisons AI coding tools, and can wipe files when a stolen GitHub token is revoked.

items.title: GitHub to Block pull_request_target Workflows by Default Starting December 2
items.summary: GitHub is tightening GitHub Actions security with new restrictions on privileged pull request workflows. Here's what changes and how maintainers are affected.

items.title: Hardening GitHub Actions Against Outside Threats
items.summary: A practical guide to securing GitHub Actions against supply chain attacks, covering malicious pull requests, credential theft, dependency risks, and release pipelines.

items.title: Composer 2.11 Adds Dependency Cooldowns
items.summary: Composer 2.11 adds dependency cooldowns, joining package managers that delay new releases to reduce supply chain risks while allowing urgent security updates.

items.title: Cursor Removes Malicious Claude Code 2.1.313 Extension From Its Marketplace
items.summary: Cursor removed a malicious Claude Code 2.1.313 extension from its marketplace. Socket examines registry records and the initial claims about its distribution.

items.title: OpenCode User Hit with Hostile Backlash After Reporting Free AI Loophole
items.summary: An OpenCode user faced harassment after reporting a free AI usage loophole, drawing a bitter backlash in a GitHub thread that has since been deleted.

items.title: Searchjacked: Hidden Browser Extensions Hijack Searches for 13 Million Users
items.summary: 319 browser extensions installed by 13.4 million users hijack searches, capture queries, and collect referral payments from Yahoo and Bing.

items.title: Malicious Firefox Extensions Impersonate Phantom, Jupiter, and Bitget to Steal Wallet Secrets
items.summary: Malicious Firefox extensions mimic Phantom, Jupiter, and Bitget wallets to steal recovery phrases and private keys, with one fetching its payload remotely.

items.title: Socket Threat Intel Now Shows Which Malware Campaigns Were Blocked or Detected
items.summary: Socket Threat Intel now shows which malware campaigns were blocked or detected in your organization, with links to scans and Firewall events.
